decisions.reason: The same-message MODIFY already captures the required toilet alignment with existing drains for Unit 3.
The same-message MODIFY already captures the toilet placement constraint for Unit 2, along with the separate Unit 2 bathroom-door instruction.
Aligning bathroom toilets with existing drains does not change the open-plan kitchen cabinetry requirement.
The drain-alignment instruction concerns bathroom toilet positions and does not change the Unit 3 kitchen-counter or bathroom-door clearance strategy.
Bathroom toilet alignment does not alter the requirement for a private steel entrance door for each dwelling.
The toilet drain-alignment constraint does not change Unit 1's 2+1 room program.
The bathroom plumbing-layout change does not affect the balcony retention policy.
Updating toilet positions to avoid existing-drain conflicts does not necessarily change the established wall preservation and partition actions.
The furnished drawing is independently introduced by another clause of the same message; the toilet drain-alignment decision does not modify it.
The bathroom toilet-position change does not affect retention or shared use of the main entrance.
